title: Rollouts
subtitle: Redeploy a set of apps in health-gated waves: a canary first, then growing waves. A failed wave halts the rollout; you resume or cancel.
empty: Start one to roll a release across your fleet wave by wave.
halt_wave_failed: A wave had more failures than allowed. Fix the failing apps, then resume to retry them, or cancel.
halt_wave_no_signal: A wave produced no successful deploy (everything failed or was skipped), so the rollout did not advance.
halt_bake_failed: An app that had passed became unhealthy, went offline or was replaced by a newer deploy during the observation window. Resume to accept the current state and move on, or cancel.
halt_interrupted: The hub restarted while a deploy was running, so its result is unknown. Check the app, then resume (it is redeployed) or cancel.
halt_initiator_lost: The person who started this rollout no longer has deploy access to one of its apps. Resuming makes you the rollout's operator.
outcome_rejected_safe: Health gate rejected the new version — the previous version is still live
outcome_queue_timeout: Deploy never left the app's queue in time
outcome_queue_full: The app's deploy queue is full
outcome_preflight: No longer eligible (moved to a swarm or lost its health-gate rollback)
haltConfirm: Halt this rollout? Deploys that have already started finish on their own; nothing new is dispatched until you resume.
resumeConfirm: Resume this rollout? You become its operator: the current wave's failed targets are redeployed under your access (after a failed observation window the rollout moves on instead); completed waves are not touched.
cancelConfirm: Cancel this rollout? Pending apps are left as they are; a deploy that has already started finishes on its own. This cannot be undone.
pickAppsHint: Only apps whose deploy is protected by a health gate with auto-rollback can join; the order you pick is the wave order.
canaryHint: Apps deployed alone first. 0 = no canary.
stepsHint: Comma-separated, increasing, ending at 100. Each wave covers this share of the apps.
bakeHint: After a wave passes, keep watching its apps this long before promoting. 0 = promote at once.
redeployNote: Each app is redeployed from its current source (image, branch or compose). Version pinning across the fleet is coming next.
blocked_ungated: No health gate with auto-rollback (compose, or auto-rollback off)
allowUngated: Include apps without a health gate (their failures can take the previous version down)
warning_auto_deploy_on: push-to-deploy is on (a push during the rollout may interleave)
invalidSteps: Waves must be increasing percentages ending at 100
name: Name (optional)
noAppsForTeam: No eligible apps in this team.
